sources.entry: TweetClaw - OpenClaw plugin and npm package for X/Twitter automation: search tweets and replies, post tweets and replies, export followers, manage media, monitor tweets, webhooks, and giveaway draws. Install with openclaw plugins install @xquik/tweetclaw.

summary.one_liner: TweetClaw is an OpenClaw plugin and npm package that lets an AI agent search, post, and manage X/Twitter data and actions through the Xquik service.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes TweetClaw as the Twitter bot plugin for OpenClaw, running on Xquik's X data API. It lets an agent search tweets, look up profiles and timelines, and run extractions such as follower or following exports and giveaway draws. It can create monitors that deliver new tweet, reply, quote, or retweet events via polling, and manage webhooks. Write actions include posting and replying, likes, retweets, follows, DMs, and media uploads. A free local `explore` tool searches a bundled API catalog without network access, and a `tweetclaw` tool invokes the catalog-listed endpoints, with 156 of 184 operations exposed. Every write, private, paid, or extraction call goes through a per-call approval prompt in OpenClaw.
use_cases: search tweets and replies on X
monitor an X account or keyword for new posts
schedule or approve posts and replies from an agent
pull X data for analysis via an agent
notable: Every write, private, paid, recurring, or extraction call requires per-call approval in OpenClaw
Free offline `explore` catalog search that works before credentials are added
Accountless pay-per-use reads via Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) on 13 routes
Covers 156 of 184 Xquik OpenAPI operations through the tweetclaw tool
Can be installed as an OpenClaw plugin, a packaged SKILL.md skill, or used through Xquik MCP with remote clients
caveats: Live API calls need an Xquik API key or prepaid credits; paid usage is billed through Xquik
28 of 184 API operations are excluded from the tool, including account settings and billing
Nix-managed OpenClaw installs disable plugin install and update commands; source builds need OpenClaw 2026.7.1 or newer
